description: Get the highest-ranked tools across the whole AgentIndex directory, for questions like "what are the best/most popular open-source AI tools right now". Ranking is by rank_score (0-100), which combines GitHub stars, how recently the repository was updated and the quality of its documentation; it is not a weekly-growth chart. Use search_tools instead when the user needs a specific kind of tool. Returns an array of {id, name, category, description, stars, rank_score, ai_tags, website, github_url}.

limit.description: Number of tools to return (1-50, default 10).

name: get_trending
title: Get top-ranked tools
